_: Made for you: one config read by the Worker (worker/src/madeForYou.ts) and the Mac runner (audio/made_for_you.py). allowanceBooks() in madeForYou.ts adds these caps to chat's own caps and worker/test/madeForYou.budget.mjs fails if any provider's free allowance is exceeded.

allowance._: Free daily allowances, as phase 3 measured them (worker/wrangler.jsonc on codex/pbs-phase-3). Gemini's 200 per model is the floor phase 3 marks SUSPECTED until read in AI Studio; when a higher RPD is confirmed there, raise it here and give made-for-you a Gemini share.

chatNeuronsPerCall._: Measured by phase 3 on her account (llama-3.1-8b risk screen, llama-3.3-70b confirm, judge and answer).

_draftNeurons: llama-3.3-70b fp8-fast at Cloudflare's published rate: 2,000 output tokens x 0.2045 + ~600 input tokens x 0.0266 neurons.
_attemptsBooked: Each session is booked at two drafts and two judgments, so one failed draft never takes another request's place.
_sessionMinutes: Measured 20 Nov 2026: one seeded session rendered, mastered and QA-checked in 7 min 38 s; the Worker's claim (draft and check) may take up to 4 min; 15 leaves room for nice 15 and the private upload.
_sessionsPerNight: The smaller of the free budget (25 judge calls / 2 attempts = 12) and the Mac (a 15-hour weeknight window / 15 min = 60).
